clips.title: The story
paras: This task marks the completion of the Rod of Transformation at the hidden shrine in Ashenvale. With the sacred artifact assembled, it must be returned immediately to the dryad Shael'dryn at her moonwell sanctuary.

The arduous effort to assemble the Rod of Transformation reaches a quiet turning point at the secluded shrine hidden deep within Ashenvale's wilds. Piecing together the shaft, pommel, and glowing gem, and re-enchanting the reconstructed rod at the hidden shrine has restored its magic. The artifact is ready to be returned to Shael'dryn for Raene's investigation of the furbolg attacks.

With the assembly complete, word and relic must be delivered swiftly back to Shael'dryn. Stationed beside the calm waters of the forest moonwell, the dryad has guided every step of this restoration effort. Presenting the assembled rod to her not only confirms that the rod's magic has been restored, but also allows the Sentinel defenders to take the next critical steps in defending their besieged homeland.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The rod, now complete, lies in your hands. Shael'dryn will want to hear of your success.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You've done it, friend! Well done!
